remarks: A tri-level 3 BR, 1.5 BATH Glenbrook townhouse, in the Spruce Meadows Condo Association, that offers terrific space with a huge open finished 3RD floor with endless possibilities. Low maintenance flooring on the main level which offers the LR/fireplace & a separate dining area, with sliders to the deck. A large kitchen compliments the space. 2 good sized BRS w/1.5Baths plus washer/dryer on the main floor also makes for easy access throughout. Steps up to a tremendously  huge open loft area provides a 3rd BR plus a study, workout area, etc.....!  Excellent storage! Central air. A detached garage and a reserved parking space are nice extras plus there is visitor parking in the repaved parking area. Over 1500 sq foot of living space! This attractive and nicely landscaped condo community is perfect for a new resident or for a 1031 tax exchange investor since it is easy to rent out!
